 Melbourne Stars vs Brisbane Heat Preview & Prediction | WBBL|12 | League Stage
 by Alex Sarwar · 9 November 2026 at 4:45 pm 
 Post 
 Share 
 Click here for today’s sports betting tips from our expert analysts! 
 Junction Oval hosts another Thursday double-header, with Melbourne Stars welcoming Brisbane Heat for the afternoon curtain-raiser. 
 Date & time: 
 12 November 2026 at 4:40 am 
 Venue: Junction Oval, Melbourne, Australia
 Weather: Mostly dry and mild, with temperatures peaking at around 19c.
 How to watch: UK – Sky Sports & Sky Go / USA – Willow TV / Australia – Visit this link for the latest TV/streaming guide for this match 
 Tickets: Click here for the latest ticket information for Melbourne Stars vs Brisbane Heat 
 Melbourne Stars vs Brisbane Heat prediction 
 Melbourne Stars sit outside the WBBL top four with half of their league stage games still to play, and they head into this contest on the back of a four-game losing streak. Brisbane Heat, meanwhile, have bounced back brilliantly from a slow start to the competition and arrive having won their last two matches.
 If the Stars are to arrest their slide, they need captain Meg Lanning at her best. Despite her team’s struggles, Lanning has accrued 202 runs across five innings so far at an average of 40.40. She is capable of big runs against any bowling attack, so back her to accumulate another substantial total, regardless of which team comes out on top.
 Melbourne Stars vs Brisbane Heat tip: Meg Lanning to score 20+ runs
